newsitem.title: LATVIA: Lithuania bourse leader Vilnius Bank at new high.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania bourse leader Vilnius Bank at new high.

text.p: Shares in leading Lithuanian bank Vilnius Bank rose to a new high on Thursday on the stock market although trade was very thin, dealers said.
Vilnius climbed to 1,220 litas from 1,150 litas amid overall central market volume of 215,000 litas and bloc trading of 65,000 litas. Just over 21,000 litas of T-bills changed hands.
Broker Suprema said its in-house index rose slightly by 0.26 percent to 1,072.
The Birzhu dairy plant dipped to 4.40 litas from 4.50 on trade of 12,150 litas while the Grigiskes paper mill rose 3.45 percent to 30 cents on trade of 27,897 litas.
